rows.note: Use 嚟自 when something originates or stems from a particular source, rather than when someone obtains it or reasons to a conclusion.

example.english: This word may derive from Latin.
example.traditional: 呢個詞可能嚟自拉丁文。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ci4 ho2 nang4 lai4 zi6 laai1 ding1 man4

rows.note: Use 得到 as the all-purpose choice when someone obtains or receives something from a source.

example.english: I derive a lot of information from this book.
example.traditional: 我從呢本書得到好多資料。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cung4 ni1 bun2 syu1 dak1 dou2 hou2 do1 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use 推斷 when a conclusion is reached through reasoning rather than simply guessed or received.

example.english: From this evidence, we can derive the conclusion that he is lying.
example.traditional: 根據呢啲證據，我哋可以推斷佢講緊大話。
example.jyutping: gan1 geoi3 ni1 di1 zing3 geoi3 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 teoi1 dyun6 keoi5 gong2 gan2 daai6 waa6
